title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
blurb: Elizabeth Bennet meets the proud Mr. Darcy in this witty and charming story about love, family, and first impressions. The dialogue is lively, and the characters feel surprisingly modern.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
blurb: Jane Eyre grows from a lonely orphan into a strong and independent woman. The novel mixes romance, mystery, and emotional drama in a way that keeps readers turning pages.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
blurb: Young Jim Hawkins sails across the sea in search of hidden treasure and dangerous pirates. It is a fast-moving adventure full of excitement, maps, and unforgettable characters like Long John Silver.

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
blurb: Anne Shirley is an imaginative girl who brings joy and chaos wherever she goes. This warm and funny story celebrates friendship, dreams, and growing up.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
blurb: A mysterious count moves from Transylvania to England, bringing fear and danger with him. The story combines suspense, horror, and adventure in a classic gothic tale.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
blurb: Sherlock Holmes uses logic and careful observation to solve strange crimes in London. Each short story is exciting, clever, and easy to enjoy in small reading sessions.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
blurb: A lonely girl discovers a hidden garden that slowly changes her life and the lives of others around her. The book is hopeful, peaceful, and filled with the beauty of nature.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
blurb: Captain Ahab leads his crew on a dangerous hunt for a giant white whale. Along the way, the novel explores obsession, courage, and life at sea.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
blurb: The four March sisters grow up together during difficult times, learning about love, work, and family. The story is heartfelt and full of memorable moments.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
blurb: A young scientist creates life, but his experiment leads to tragedy and loneliness. This famous novel raises timeless questions about science, responsibility, and humanity.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
blurb: A scientist travels far into the future and discovers a strange new world. The story is short, imaginative, and one of the earliest great science fiction adventures.

title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
blurb: The cold-hearted Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by ghosts who show him the meaning of kindness and generosity. It is a touching holiday story with an uplifting message.
